When that event occurs, the market will update rapidly: (1) 48h clock starts for the announcement itself, (2) the security architecture model is confirmed (burial first = controlled process), (3) the no-alternative signal completes its run. The market has moved from 42% to 63% on no specific verifiable events — just the strengthening absence signal. A verifiable public trigger (burial date) will produce an accelerated move. 75% is a conservative target: burial announcement should push the market to 70-80% in the same session. Set at 72% probability because (a) burial announcement might not come before March 20 deadline, and (b) market might absorb the burial news more slowly than expected if it occurs outside trading hours or alongside confusing secondary news.

title: Ali Khamenei state burial ceremony happens after March 15

A burial before March 15 would require either (a) Mojtaba's presence at a disclosed location (targeting risk) or (b) his notable absence (legitimacy cost). The IRGC will choose to wait. After March 15, the targeting window risk decreases substantially — not to zero, but from acute to manageable. A March 16-20 burial is the clean window: peak risk passed, Nowruz not yet forcing a combined ceremony.
